full_local_service_ms.description: Full local pipeline: regex tokenization, vocabulary mapping, tensor creation, forward pass, temperature-scaled softmax, Top-K extraction, and word mapping (200 warm iterations)

latencies.note_on_historical_0_33ms: The 0.331 ms value was the batched per-sample amortized time during DataLoader evaluation (batch_size=256), whereas single-item online inference latency is ~1.2-1.4 ms for forward pass and ~1.8 ms for the full service.

baseline_comparison.baseline_model: Unigram Frequency Baseline (Predicts most frequent training tokens)

generalization_gap_analysis.train_test_gap_explanation: High train accuracy (83.5%) vs test accuracy (15.2%) reflects sequence memorization typical of small-vocabulary LSTMs without pretrained transformers. However, BiLSTM Top-1 (15.18%) and Top-5 (27.44%) vastly outperform the unigram baseline (3.56%) and random guessing (0.014%), demonstrating genuine sequential syntactic and semantic learning.

historical_comparison.notebook_validation_split: None (trained on full dataset without holdout split)
historical_comparison.notebook_leakage_note: No test/val split was performed in the original Final.ipynb notebook. Evaluation on train set alone overstates generalization.
